security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives after reviewing the referenced files. The scripts process local CSV and transcript files, and the flagged high-risk patterns are display ellipses or dictionary key access rather than path traversal or certificate access.

remediation.issue: Static analysis noise from domain terms such as requests and keys.
remediation.suggestion: Rename local variables where practical, or add comments clarifying that they are feature requests and CSV field names.

remediation.issue: Local transcript analysis may expose sensitive research data in terminal output.
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should redact confidential customer information before sharing outputs outside the local environment.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 118 stores the result of _classify_request in a local dictionary for interview analysis. It does not import or call an HTTP client.
Line 281 defines _classify_request for categorizing feature-request text. The word request is domain terminology, not network access.
Line 116 appends to a local list named requests. There is no Python requests import or outbound network operation in this context.
Line 382 formats a truncated quote with an ellipsis for display. The three dots are not a filesystem path and are not used for path traversal.
Line 240 writes a hardcoded sample CSV when the user explicitly runs the sample command. It is intended local output, not arbitrary file overwrite or exfiltration.
Line 288 calls prioritized[0].keys() to print CSV column names. It does not reference certificate files, private keys, or secrets.

content.user_title: Prioritize Product Work With Research Signals
content.value_statement: Product teams need consistent ways to prioritize work and synthesize research. This skill provides RICE scoring, interview analysis, PRD templates, and discovery frameworks.
actual_capabilities: Scores feature ideas with the RICE framework using reach, impact, confidence, and effort inputs.
Generates portfolio analysis with quick wins, big bets, total effort, total reach, and average RICE score.
Builds capacity-aware quarterly roadmap suggestions from prioritized feature lists.
Extracts pain points, feature requests, jobs to be done, themes, metrics, and quotes from interview transcripts.
Provides PRD, agile epic, one-page PRD, and feature brief templates for different planning stages.
Documents discovery, metrics, stakeholder management, and go-to-market workflows for product teams.
limitations: The scripts use rule-based text analysis, not a trained research model.
RICE scores depend on the accuracy of user-provided reach, impact, confidence, and effort estimates.
Transcript analysis runs on local text files and does not anonymize sensitive customer data automatically.
Roadmap output is a planning aid and does not replace dependency review with engineering and design leads.

use_cases.title: Prioritize a Feature Backlog
use_cases.description: Score candidate features, compare effort tradeoffs, and identify high-value work before roadmap planning.

use_cases.title: Synthesize Customer Interviews
use_cases.description: Turn interview transcripts into pain points, feature requests, jobs to be done, themes, and useful quotes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Planning Documents
use_cases.description: Use structured PRD and epic templates to align teams on problem, scope, requirements, metrics, and launch plans.

prompt_templates.title: Score a Small Feature List
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me score these feature ideas with RICE. Ask for any missing reach, impact, confidence, or effort values before ranking them.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the customer interview workflow to summarize this transcript. Highlight pain points, feature requests, jobs to be done, themes, metrics, and the strongest quotes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a PRD From Discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PRD templates to draft a concise product requirements document from this discovery summary. Include problem, target users, scope, requirements, metrics, risks, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Quarterly Roadmap Narrative
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the RICE and roadmap workflows to create a quarterly plan from these scored features. Explain capacity tradeoffs, quick wins, big bets, deferred work, and stakeholder messaging.

output_examples.input: A list of candidate features with reach, impact, confidence, effort, and short descriptions.
output: Ranked feature list with RICE scores and the strongest opportunities first.
Portfolio summary showing quick wins, big bets, total effort, and average score.
Suggested quarterly roadmap based on the selected team capacity.

output_examples.input: A customer interview transcript about onboarding friction and reporting needs.
output: Pain point summary with severity labels and supporting quotes.
Feature request list grouped by request type and priority.
Themes, sentiment, metrics mentioned, and competitor references.

output_examples.input: Discovery notes for a proposed analytics dashboard feature.
output_examples.output: A PRD outline with problem statement, target users, solution scope, acceptance criteria, success metrics, risks, timeline, and launch considerations.

best_practices: Use real customer, usage, and revenue data when estimating reach and impact.
Review generated interview insights with the original transcript before making roadmap decisions.
Keep PRDs focused on the customer problem, success metrics, scope, and unresolved decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat RICE scores as final decisions without strategy, dependencies, and risk review.
Do not paste confidential interview data into shared outputs without consent and redaction.
Do not use PRD templates to expand scope after stakeholders have agreed on the MVP.

faq.question: Does this skill run product analysis automatically?
faq.answer: It provides scripts and workflows that process local CSV files or text transcripts when the user chooses to run them.

faq.question: What input does the RICE prioritizer need?
faq.answer: It works best with feature name, reach, impact, confidence, effort, and an optional description for each feature.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple interviews at once?
faq.answer: The script includes aggregation helpers, but the documented command focuses on analyzing one transcript file at a time.

faq.question: Does the interview analyzer use an external AI service?
faq.answer: No evidence found of external AI calls. The script uses local rule-based matching and simple text analysis.

faq.question: Which PRD formats are included?
faq.answer: The reference material includes standard PRD, one-page PRD, agile epic, and feature brief formats.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
